players.name: Drake Maye
players.note: Maye left the Nov. 15 loss to Detroit in Munich early (48 passing yards, per Sleeper stats), and Sleeper now lists him as out (ESPN's Week 10 takeaways refer to Tommy DeVito starting in his place). Postgame reports cite an ankle injury, but no MRI result or timeline was confirmed as of Monday morning; New England has its Week 11 bye.

players.name: Fernando Mendoza
players.note: He made his first NFL start in a 21-13 home loss to Seattle on Nov. 15, and his 10-yard rushing touchdown in the first quarter was the highlight. He remains the Raiders' starter.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Postgame reports say his first NFL start, against the Rams on Nov. 15, could hardly have gone worse. He is still Arizona's starter because Gardner Minshew is on IR for the season.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: Filling in for the injured Kyler Murray, he led the Vikings to a 30-10 win at Green Bay on Nov. 15, their most points since Week 1. Minnesota is targeting a Week 12 return for Murray, so Cousins should start at least once more.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: He missed the Week 10 win at Green Bay with a Grade 2 hamstring strain while Kirk Cousins started. As of Nov. 14, ESPN reported Minnesota was targeting a Week 12 return vs. Atlanta on Nov. 29.

players.name: Deshaun Watson
players.note: He started for Cleveland on Nov. 15, and the Browns came back from 17 points down to beat Houston 27-24 with a touchdown in the final minute. The win should ease talk of reopening the QB competition with Shedeur Sanders.

players.name: Shedeur Sanders
players.note: He stayed on the bench while Deshaun Watson started and Cleveland rallied to beat Houston 27-24 on Nov. 15. The win makes it less likely he gets another start soon.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: He missed Week 10 with quad and rib injuries, and Seattle won 21-13 at Las Vegas without him. The Seahawks are on bye in Week 11, so Week 12 is the earliest he can return.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: Tampa Bay was on bye in Week 10. Mayfield hurt his lower leg in the Nov. 8 loss to Chicago, has been in and out of a walking boot, and is uncertain for Week 11 vs. Detroit on Nov. 22; IR is not being considered.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: Baltimore acquired him from Arizona at the deadline, and he starts for the Ravens tonight (MNF, Nov. 16) vs. the Chargers with Lamar Jackson on IR.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He remains on IR after right-thumb surgery and is likely out for the season. Jacoby Brissett starts for Baltimore on MNF, Nov. 16.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR with blood clots that require blood thinners, and the latest reports say he is likely out for the rest of 2026.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR and is reported as lost for the season. J.J. McCarthy is starting for the Giants.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: Miami placed him on IR on Nov. 10 with a groin/core-muscle injury, so he will miss at least four games. Kyle McCord is starting in his place.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: He played through a hip injury on TNF Nov. 12 and threw for a career-high 293 yards in a 24-21 loss to Washington. He remains the Giants' starter with Jaxson Dart out for the season.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: The Eagles were on bye in Week 10. As of Nov. 11 they had not named a starter for Nov. 22 vs. Pittsburgh, so Tanner McKee is still in the mix.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: Making his first NFL start in place of Kenneth Walker III on Nov. 15 vs. Atlanta, Johnson had 171 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns (32.1 half-PPR points) in the win. He has a strong case for a bigger share even once Walker returns.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: Walker (groin) missed the Week 10 win at Atlanta on Nov. 15, and rookie Emmett Johnson broke out in his place with 171 scrimmage yards and 2 TDs. The Chiefs had framed the absence as short-term, but Johnson's performance could cut into Walker's workload.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Marks suffered a concussion in the third quarter against Cleveland on Nov. 15 and did not return, finishing with 65 total yards on 13 touches. He now has to clear the concussion protocol before Week 11.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) missed the Week 10 loss at Cleveland on Nov. 15. With Woody Marks now in the concussion protocol, Montgomery could take on a larger role if he is healthy for Week 11.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Jacobs (fractured finger, surgery Nov. 13) missed the 30-10 home loss to Minnesota on Nov. 15. He was not placed on IR, so the expected absence is about 2-3 weeks.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: Starting for the injured Josh Jacobs, Johnson ran 10 times for 42 yards in the 30-10 loss to Minnesota on Nov. 15. He should keep the lead role while Jacobs is out, and one Packers report argues he should remain the starter even after Jacobs returns.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.note: Per Sleeper's Week 10 stats (Nov. 15), Williams had just 12 carries for 23 yards plus 2 catches for 9 yards, while Blake Corum out-carried him 17-12. The Rams appear to be moving toward a committee.

players.name: Blake Corum
players.note: Corum out-carried Kyren Williams 17-12 in Week 10 (Nov. 15) and had 100 rushing yards and a TD plus 3 catches for 19 yards, per Sleeper stats. That points to a growing role in the Rams backfield.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Skattebo returned from a hamstring injury and handled a featured role for the Giants against Washington on Thursday, Nov. 12.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: The Ravens list Randall as questionable for Monday night (Nov. 16) against the Chargers, pending his activation from injured reserve. Reports differ on the injury: Yahoo lists his foot, while NFL.com lists neck/hamstring.

players.name: Nicholas Singleton
players.note: Singleton was a healthy scratch (coach's decision) for Tennessee's Week 10 game against Jacksonville on Nov. 15, as Tony Pollard and Tyjae Spears both played.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: The Patriots placed Henderson (illness) on injured reserve on Nov. 14, so he will miss at least four games. Rhamondre Stevenson, playing through a knee issue, had a quiet game as the lead back on Nov. 15.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Brooks (groin) remains on injured reserve as of Nov. 15. His practice window has been opened, but he was considered unlikely to play in Week 10.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) remains on IR as of Nov. 15. With Jonah Coleman established as the lead back, Harvey's workload is likely to be reduced when he returns.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (high ankle sprain) has been on IR since Nov. 3 and is expected to miss 4-5 weeks.

players.name: Demond Claiborne
players.note: Claiborne (knee) has been on injured reserve since Nov. 9.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Bowers hurt his right ankle on the opening drive of the Week 10 loss to Seattle (Nov 15) and was ruled out for the rest of the game. Per Ian Rapoport it is not believed to be major: he is considered day-to-day and will have more tests Monday (Nov 16) ahead of Week 11 vs. Denver.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: Kelce aggravated his right ankle on his first catch vs. Atlanta on Nov 15 but returned to the game, and Andy Reid said a related calf issue came from the same play. Kelce says he does not expect to miss time; reports that he will be out for weeks are unconfirmed.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Hockenson (wrist/chest) sat out Week 10 at Green Bay on Nov 15, and there is still no timeline for his return. Ben Yurosek and Gavin Bartholomew are handling the Vikings' TE snaps.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (left knee PCL/MCL sprain) missed Week 10 vs. San Francisco on Nov 15 and is expected to miss multiple weeks. Brevyn Spann-Ford and Luke Schoonmaker are splitting the TE work.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (hamstring) is still on IR and missed Week 10. As of Nov 14, Sean McVay said he would miss "another couple weeks."

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.note: After the Nov 10 trades of Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, Warren is Indianapolis' top remaining pass-catcher. He carries no injury designation.

players.name: Tyler Higbee
players.note: Puka Nacua faces a multi-week absence and Davante Adams is on IR (as of Nov 15), so the Rams' passing game is thin. Higbee has been the lead TE, with an 80% snap share in a recent game vs. Washington.

players.name: Drake London
players.note: London did not return to the Nov 15 Week 10 game vs. Kansas City after a late concussion evaluation, finishing with 6 catches for 109 yards. It is unclear whether he has a concussion; watch for protocol news this week.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Sleeper's Week 10 stats show Brown played in the Nov 15 loss to Detroit in Munich (2 catches, 27 yards), and Sleeper now lists him as out. The exact injury and timeline are unconfirmed; New England has its Week 11 bye.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: No Patriots player reached 10 fantasy points in Week 10 (Nov 15), per ESPN, which advises avoiding New England's offense with Tommy DeVito at quarterback.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: Deadline addition Josh Downs made an immediate impact in his Chiefs debut Nov 15, a game in which Patrick Mahomes threw for 348 yards and 5 TDs. That pushes Allen further down the target pecking order.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: Jennings (calf) missed his second straight game Nov 15 at Green Bay after missing all three practices. Watch his Week 11 practice status.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Addison (thumb) was ruled out for the Nov 15 game at Green Bay after the injury was added to the report Nov 13. His Week 11 status is unclear.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Bell (knee) was out for the Nov 15 game at Indianapolis after Miami listed him doubtful Nov 13.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate (shoulder) was ruled out for the Nov 15 game vs. Jacksonville. His return timeline for Week 11 is unclear.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (hamstring) is doubtful for Monday night's Nov 16 game vs. Baltimore after missing practice Nov 12-13. It would be his third straight missed game.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel returned from a three-game hamstring absence for San Francisco's 46-40 win over Dallas on Nov 15. Mike Evans (Achilles) is out, which keeps targets open for him.

players.name: Deion Burks
players.note: With Josh Downs and Keenan Allen traded Nov 10 and Alec Pierce's 2026 return in doubt, Burks stays among the Colts' top receivers. Indianapolis leaned on the run in Week 10 (Nov 15) vs. Miami.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: On Nov 11 Shane Steichen said he is unsure whether Pierce (heel, IR since Week 3) will return in 2026.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: As of Nov 15 there was still no report of Aiyuk being activated, traded or released. San Francisco faces a decision deadline around Nov 23.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) has missed three straight games and Philadelphia was on bye in Week 10. He could return as early as Week 11.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Waddle (concussion, Nov 8) went through the protocol during Denver's Week 10 bye. He is aiming to return Nov 22 vs. Las Vegas.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams (hamstring, IR) is targeting a return around Weeks 12-13, after the Rams' Week 11 bye. Puka Nacua is also on IR.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Cooper left the Jets' Nov 15 loss to Buffalo with an ankle injury, and he has a history of a high ankle sprain this season. Adonai Mitchell is being touted as a waiver pickup in his place.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) remains on IR, and New England's outlook worsened in the Nov 15 35-10 loss to Detroit: Drake Maye left with an ankle injury that early reports call significant and possibly season-ending, and A.J. Brown left with a hamstring injury.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.note: Jordan Addison (thumb) and Jauan Jennings were both inactive for Minnesota's Nov 15 game at Green Bay, which concentrates targets on Jefferson alongside the Kirk Cousins reunion.

players.name: Ryan Flournoy
players.note: Yahoo named Flournoy one of the top Week 11 waiver adds after Week 10 games (Nov 16); Dallas played Nov 15 without TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle).

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (Achilles) sat out again Nov 15 at Dallas and has now missed consecutive games with no return timeline reported.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: With Mike Evans (Achilles) out again Nov 15 at Dallas, Allen was in line for his 49ers debut after the Nov 10 trade from Indianapolis and should see a sizable role while Evans is sidelined.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison (hamstring) missed the Nov 15 game vs. Cleveland, and Houston plays again on Thursday night, so the short week puts his Week 11 availability in doubt.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey (back) is listed out for the Chargers' Monday night game at Baltimore on Nov 16 after being active but not playing in Week 9.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring) missed his second straight game on Nov 15 vs. Kansas City; no return timeline has been reported.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Nacua (MCL/PCL sprains, turf toe) has been on IR since Nov 12 and must miss at least four games; with the Rams' Week 11 bye, Week 15 is reportedly his earliest return.

players.name: Josh Downs
players.note: Downs was set to debut for Kansas City on Nov 15 at Atlanta after the Nov 10 trade from Indianapolis; his early role is expected to be limited while he learns the offense.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Burden (concussion, Nov 8) is still in the protocol per Sleeper; Chicago's Week 10 bye gave him extra time to clear before Week 11.

players.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
players.note: Sleeper listed Robinson questionable (ankle) as of the evening of Nov 15; check his practice participation this week.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: Pittman (foot) remained on IR without an opened practice window and missed Nov 15 vs. Cincinnati; a return after Pittsburgh's bye is the earliest reported.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Wilson (finger) remains on IR with no return date reported as of Nov 15.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season with a neck fracture suffered Nov 8 vs. Seattle (announced Nov 9).

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19 and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Lamar Jackson remains on IR heading into Baltimore's Monday night game vs. the Chargers on Nov 16, so Flowers' outlook stays depressed with a rookie at QB.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Hill remains an unsigned free agent coming off ACL surgery as of mid-November, and the NFL says his personal-conduct matter is still under review, so a signing team could face a suspension.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Rodriguez (hand) is listed questionable for Week 10 on Sleeper as of Nov. 11. He played through the hand issue in Week 9 and scored a TD.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Kincaid (ankle) was limited at practice again on Thursday, Nov 12, matching Wednesday. He played through the injury in Week 9 and still looks on track for Sunday at the Jets.

players.name: Emanuel Wilson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:03 PM PT Nov 15.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:03 PM PT Nov 15. Earlier: Mitchell (knee) is questionable for the Nov 15 game vs. Buffalo, per the Jets' Nov 13 final report. If Garrett Wilson clears the concussion protocol, Mitchell would lose his lead-receiver role.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:29 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Tuten (ankle) is listed questionable for Week 10 on Sleeper as of Nov. 11. He played through the same issue in Week 9 and scored a TD.

players.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Fannin (groin) was limited in practice again on Thursday, Nov 12, ahead of Sunday's game vs. Houston. It is his second straight week managing the groin issue.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Harris is listed questionable (shoulder) as of Nov 12 ahead of the Chargers' Monday night game vs. Baltimore.

players.name: Ty Simpson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:03 PM PT Nov 15.

players.name: Drew Allar
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 5:03 PM PT Nov 15.

players.name: Taylen Green
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:03 PM PT Nov 15.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:03 PM PT Nov 15. Earlier: Boston (toe) is questionable for the Nov 15 game vs. Houston. Todd Monken said Nov 13 that he is 'trending in the right direction.'

players.name: Jack Strand
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:03 PM PT Nov 15.

players.name: Geno Smith
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (ankle) as of 1:03 PM PT Nov 15.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:29 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Henry (foot) was limited in practice again on Thursday, Nov 12. Barring a setback, he is expected to play Sunday against Detroit.

players.name: Drew Lock
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Mike Macdonald said tests on his oblique came back good and that he expects Lock to start Sunday at Las Vegas with Sam Darnold out. He has been limited all week with elbow/oblique issues and carries a questionable tag.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:29 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Sleeper lists Meyers questionable (ankle) as of Nov 11. No Week 10 practice participation was confirmed as of Nov 12.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Pollard (finger) was added to the injury report and listed questionable for Week 10 on Sleeper as of Nov. 12.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:03 PM PT Nov 15. Earlier: The Saints activated Etienne (hamstring) from injured reserve on Saturday, Nov. 14, ahead of Week 10 against Carolina. He carries a questionable designation after practicing through the week.

players.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 7:40 AM PT Nov 15. Earlier: Detroit's Nov 13 final report lists St. Brown questionable (ribs) for the Nov 15 game in Munich after limited practice. Reports call him likely to play.

players.name: Rashod Bateman
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13.

players.name: Pat Freiermuth
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:03 PM PT Nov 15. Earlier: The Steelers added Freiermuth (illness) to the injury report on Saturday, Nov. 14, and he is questionable for Sunday night's Week 10 game at Cincinnati, though he is expected to play through it. If he sits, Darnell Washington and Robert Tonyan would absorb the TE work, and Pittsburgh's inactives come out at 6:50 PM ET.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 7:40 AM PT Nov 15. Earlier: Stevenson (knee) is officially active for the Nov. 15 game against Detroit in Munich after being listed questionable. He was limited Thursday and Friday and may not be at 100%, but Henderson's move to IR leaves him as the lead back.

players.name: Zonovan Knight
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:29 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Knight (concussion) was limited in practice Nov. 11 and is questionable for Week 10 vs. the Rams. If cleared, he should share work with Tyler Allgeier.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Pickens (hamstring) is questionable after being inactive for the Nov 8 game vs. Indianapolis. Some Week 10 reports say he was limited on Wednesday, Nov 11, but official confirmation was unclear as of Nov 12.

players.name: Garrett Wilson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:03 PM PT Nov 15. Earlier: Wilson (concussion) is questionable for the Nov 15 game vs. Buffalo. Aaron Glenn said he is 'very hopeful' Wilson plays, and Wilson reportedly practiced fully Friday, Nov 13.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:03 PM PT Nov 15. Earlier: Spears (knee) practiced fully Friday, Nov. 13, after sitting Wednesday and being limited Thursday. He remains questionable for Week 10 against Jacksonville and is the Titans' only questionable player.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:04 PM PT Nov 14.
